dialogues.speaker: Kazuhiro
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、最後に勉強のポイントを教えてあげ
　ましょう」
dialogues.en:
"Now, make sure you study these points before the exams
tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"Now, make sure you study these points before the exams
tomorrow."

dialogues.jp:
瞬時に教室の中が静まり、いかなる音も聞き逃
すまいと耳をすます。
dialogues.en:
In an instant, the entire classroom become so silent that
you could hear a pin drop.
dialogues.text:
In an instant, the entire classroom become so silent that
you could hear a pin drop.

dialogues.speaker: Kazuhiro
dialogues.jp:
「いいですか。何度もいいますが勉強の｛・・・／ポイン｝
　｛・／ト｝ですからね」
dialogues.en:
"No matter what, if you study nothing else, make sure you
study these points at least."
dialogues.text:
"No matter what, if you study nothing else, make sure you
study these points at least."

dialogues.jp: 分かってるさ。みなまで言うな。
dialogues.en: We know already, just tell us.
dialogues.text: We know already, just tell us.

dialogues.speaker: Kazuhiro
dialogues.jp:
「まず、教科書の９８ページに書かれていると
　ころは、かなり重要だと僕は思いますね」
dialogues.en:
"I believe page 98 of the textbook will be very important in
the coming exam..."
dialogues.text:
"I believe page 98 of the textbook will be very important in
the coming exam..."

dialogues.jp: カリカリとメモを取る音が響く。
dialogues.en:
The sound of several pencils scribbling on paper was heard
throughout the classroom.
dialogues.text:
The sound of several pencils scribbling on paper was heard
throughout the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
英語の和宏先生はとにかくありがたい人だ。な
にせ勉強の｛・・・・／ポイント｝を教えてくれる。
dialogues.en:
Our english teacher, Kazuhiro-sensei, is the best. He always
tells us what to study before the exams.
dialogues.text:
Our english teacher, Kazuhiro-sensei, is the best. He always
tells us what to study before the exams.

dialogues.jp:
なになに……９８ページだって。みな、真剣に
メモを取っていた。
dialogues.en:
So, it's page 98. Everyone seriously noted down this on
their papers.
dialogues.text:
So, it's page 98. Everyone seriously noted down this on
their papers.
